dedupe_keys.name: my vid a malaysian vehicle image dataset for intelligent transportation system and road safety

description: Sunway University researchers publish MY-VID version 2, roadside images for vehicle detection on a Malaysian expressway. The free CC BY 4.0 Zenodo archive contains 8,832 JPEG images and YOLO text annotations for 47,975 vehicles. Six classes follow the Malaysian road authority classification, with observations spanning day, night and varied weather or traffic conditions. These samples can calibrate traffic-observation components used to infer demand in transport simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this annotated collection. Geographic coverage is one expressway observation setting, not a national traffic census. A limitation is that class imbalance, correlated frames and changing camera conditions may affect evaluation independence and transfer. Acquisition dates and annotation accuracy were not independently verified. No images were downloaded or detector trained.
